ambiguities: The paper gives no horizon; Weekly chosen to match the library's engagement and exhaustion constructs.
Job demands are listed by example; the bundle uses the three examples named on p. 312 (work pressure, emotional demands, role conflict).
Propositions 1 and 2 are stated as 'most important predictors'; encoded as unconditional positive relations with meta-analytic evidence cited by the paper's review, not by original data.
